# MM9PDY's to-stock patch (UV-5R Mini, NRF V0.27, loader 1.1.0)

An unmodified copy of `releases/baofeng-uv5rmini/to-stock/uv5rmini-fw-to-stock-nrf-v0.27-hw1.7-1.1.0.patch.json`
from [pskillen/mm9pdy-firmware](https://github.com/pskillen/mm9pdy-firmware) at commit `6f23730a`, with that
repository's `LICENSE.md` (which allows redistributing release patches unmodified, with the notice). SHA-256
`dd515ff9…0cdd30`. The web page loads it from here, falling back to MM9PDY's repo. It holds MM9PDY's update loader,
not Baofeng's firmware: the patch is applied to each user's own stock file.
